messages:
ana: Heads-up — nightly model-refresh failed at ~02:13 UTC. Job hung on 'acquire_cache_lease' and then worker OOM. Leaving model cache locked. Anyone around?

matt: looking... can you paste the last few lines of the worker logs?

ana: pasted:
```
ERROR: failed to renew lease for model_cache: rpc error: code=Unavailable desc=connection closed
[2026-03-15T02:13:22Z] goroutine 312: runtime: out of memory
```

bench-bot: nightly-bench/v2 (run 2026-03-15) failed: exit code 1 — tests aborted during model pull. Link: https://ci.redwood/1234

liam: assigning to infra triage. Could be a quota spike in us-west2 or flapping redis. Re-ran the job (id: 1765432105) and added tracing.

sophia: FYI cleanup cron also didn't finish, left partial artifacts in /mnt/ssd/cache. Might be related.

matt: trying a manual lease release now: `redis-cli -h cache-01 del model_cache:lease` — will monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy/worker-restart triggered by matt — worker/worker-12 restarted.

ana: after restart, model-refresh started but slowed, still seeing intermittent RPC Unavailable errors.

liam: short plan: 1) monitor restarted worker, 2) add retry+backoff to lease renew, 3) add alert if cleanup takes >10m. I'll own the alerting PR.

sophia: I can do the retry PR today, pinging @matt for quick review.

matt: opening PR for lease retry + extra logging, will link shortly.

ana: thanks — I'll watch CI and follow up with logs and a quick postmortem if it doesn't stabilize :thumbsup:
